prompt: Read-only FormulaLM health check. Check kolibri-formulalm service status, http://10.99.0.1:8004/api/v1/health, latest /srv/kolibri/repo/data/models/formulalm_trained_*.npz checkpoint metadata, disk space, RAM pressure, and whether a training lock or active train_formulalm.py process exists. Do not start training, stop services, restart services, edit files, read secrets, or expose corpus contents. Return summary, blockers, checkpoint age, API status, and recommended next actions.

quality_contract.objective: Verify FormulaLM training/API health without exposing corpus contents or changing the training node.
quality_contract.context: FormulaLM is a dedicated Home server responsibility and must remain stable before agent rollout expands.
scope: Inspect FormulaLM service status, health endpoint, checkpoint metadata, disk pressure, RAM pressure, and training lock state.
Report checkpoint freshness and whether inference/training are currently safe.
Keep all corpus and model artifacts private; report metadata only.
out_of_scope: Do not start training, stop services, restart services, edit files, or copy model artifacts.
Do not read secrets, auth files, .env files, .ssh, or .mimocode.
Do not expose raw corpus rows, prompts, private documents, or model payloads.
acceptance_criteria: Return FormulaLM API health status and checkpoint age or absence.
Return whether an active training process or lock exists.
Return blockers and safe next actions for Codex review.
verification_steps: Check service status and the VPN-only health endpoint.
Inspect model checkpoint metadata without dumping model content.
Check disk and memory pressure relevant to training stability.
deliverables: Structured result with status, summary, changed_files, checks, risks, and artifacts.
FormulaLM readiness decision: ready, degraded, or blocked.
Recommended next action for training/API maintenance.
stop_conditions: Stop if a step requires credentials, tokens, private keys, auth files, or corpus content disclosure.
Stop if a health check would mutate training state or service state.
